title: Okehazama (1560)
hook: Rumors of Imagawa's vast army marching on Owari; Oda's retainers whisper of a desperate dawn strike in the rain.

title: Azuchi Castle rises (1576)
hook: Nobunaga's impossible castle climbs the hill; masons, painters, and Jesuit observers crowd the town.

title: Nagashino (1575)
hook: Word of Oda-Tokugawa arquebus lines behind palisades; Takeda cavalry dead in the mud. War ghosts walk.

title: Honno-ji (1582)
hook: Unease in the capital: Mitsuhide's banners move by night. No one says it aloud yet.

title: Sekigahara (1600)
hook: East and west armies gather; every road south smells of rain and iron.

title: Sakai merchant fire (local)
hook: A warehouse fire on the merchant row — accident, or a rival's curse? The guild wants an onmyoji's verdict.

title: Jesuit chapel dispute (local)
hook: Padres and temple priests dispute a burial ground; the dead, locals say, have opinions.

title: Odawara siege rumors (1590)
hook: Hideyoshi's host rings the Hojo walls; inside, hunger sharpens old grudges into hauntings.

title: Nakasendo night ghost (recurring)
hook: Travelers speak of a weeping woman at the pass who asks for her child's name.

title: Osaka unrest (1614)
hook: Ronin drift toward Osaka castle; monks preach doom; the air tastes of coming siege.
